sentences.text: `` Happiness in Slavery '' is a song by American industrial rock band Nine Inch Nails from their debut extended play -LRB- EP -RRB- , Broken -LRB- 1992 -RRB- .	Nine Inch Nails	Nine Inch Nails	Broken	Broken (EP)	industrial rock	industrial rock
It was released in November 1992 as a promotional single from the EP .	promotional single	promotional single

The song takes its title and refrain from Jean Paulhan 's preface to Pauline Réage 's 1954 erotic novel Story of O. `` Happiness in Slavery '' peaked at number 13 on the US Billboard Modern Rock Tracks chart . Nine Inch Nails ' performance of `` Happiness in Slavery '' at Woodstock ' 94 , included on the concert 's compilation album , won the Grammy Award for Best Metal Performance in 1996 .	Nine Inch Nails	Nine Inch Nails	Grammy Award for Best Metal Performance	Grammy Award for Best Metal Performance
The song 's music video was almost universally banned for its depiction of Bob Flanagan being tortured by a machine .	Bob Flanagan	Bob Flanagan
